description: The humerus is the long bone of the upper arm, bridging the shoulder and elbow with sweeping surfaces that artists use to place the arm's major forms.

landmarks.name: Head of the humerus
landmarks.desc: Smooth hemispherical surface that articulates with the glenoid cavity and suggests the rounded cap of the shoulder.

landmarks.name: Greater tubercle
landmarks.desc: Prominent lateral mass where the rotator cuff tendons converge, giving the shoulder breadth.

landmarks.name: Lesser tubercle
landmarks.desc: Anterior bump that marks the insertion of subscapularis and hints at the bicipital groove.

landmarks.name: Bicipital groove
landmarks.desc: Intertubercular sulcus guiding the tendon of the long head of biceps and channels the upper arm's highlight.

landmarks.name: Deltoid tuberosity
landmarks.desc: Roughened lateral ridge halfway down the shaft where the deltoid inserts, anchoring the arm's tapering mass.

landmarks.name: Radial groove
landmarks.desc: Posterior spiral groove that carries the radial nerve between the medial and lateral heads of triceps.

landmarks.name: Posterior humerus superior to radial groove
landmarks.desc: Smooth triangular surface above the radial groove that anchors the lateral head of triceps.

landmarks.name: Posterior humerus inferior to radial groove
landmarks.desc: Broad posterior plane below the radial groove where the medial head of triceps attaches.

landmarks.name: Medial epicondyle
landmarks.desc: Large medial projection at the distal end, easily palpated and home to many flexor origins.

landmarks.name: Lateral epicondyle
landmarks.desc: Smaller lateral projection providing the anchor for the common extensor tendon.

landmarks.name: Trochlea
landmarks.desc: Medial spool-shaped articular surface that receives the ulna and defines the hinge of the elbow.

landmarks.name: Capitulum
landmarks.desc: Rounded lateral condyle that meets the radial head and gives the distal humerus its spherical contour.
